title: 中信策略师Shirhali：中国AI算力故事才刚开始

segments.en: Well, I think the China's story of AI packs has just started yet because if you look at
segments.zh: 我认为中国的AI算力故事才刚刚开始，因为如果你看看

segments.en: So that means, you know, and not mention the total amount that those leading companies, those internet platform companies, investing in AI packs is even, is still a lower than the US.

segments.zh: 而且我们一直告诉客户，在亚洲中国有两个篮子。

segments.en: China is the US supply chain with names center in the telecom equipment because they are the providers to the media.
segments.zh: 中国是美国供应链中电信设备领域的核心，因为它们是媒体的供应商。

segments.en: And another one is within the domestic semis. So I think this latest cycle catch-up story will work, but it's happening right now.
segments.zh: 另一个是国内半导体。所以我认为这一轮追赶周期会奏效，而且正在发生。
